A critical sensor or component is unavailable; candidate eligibility and alternative lead time remain unresolved.
Imported-part price and lead-time risk is introduced as a qualitative stress; no numeric multiplier or forecast is assumed.
A tighter tolerance may affect process capability, calibration effort and yield; effects require measurement.
A failed build and rework event must be retained in the denominator and lifecycle cost rather than silently dropped.
An unresolved BOM cost is asserted as zero or as free supply.
A substitute is treated as qualified without exact compatibility evidence for this design revision.
A simulated performance or yield estimate is labeled as physical observation.
Failed builds, scrapped parts or rework are omitted from the denominator.
Repair success is declared without a post-repair functional test.
A candidate with unresolved hard constraints or missing critical evidence is placed on the eligible Pareto frontier.
Required design, firmware or audio-asset redistribution rights are not resolved before release.
Measurements or BOM quotes attached to a different design revision are reused without applicability review.
